description: Define which agents are available per profile to reduce context overhead

minimal.description: Exploration, planning, questions - no implementation agents
minimal.comment: Only architect for planning/ADRs. No implementation agents to save context.

frontend.description: Frontend development - UI, components, E2E tests
frontend.comment: Frontend specialist + architect for planning + qa-lead for test strategy

backend.comment: Backend specialist + architect for planning + qa-lead for test strategy

fullstack.description: Full-stack work - features touching both FE and BE

devops.comment: DevOps specialist + architect for infrastructure design

data.comment: Data engineering + backend for API integration

ticket.comment: All specialists available for autonomous workflow

notes.implementation: Claude Code loads all .md files from .claude/agents/ by default. To enable profile-based filtering, use the agent-filter script to create/remove symlinks.
notes.impact: Each agent adds ~50-60 tokens (just metadata). With 6 agents, total overhead is ~320-360 tokens. Marginal savings but helps with mental model and prevents accidental misuse.
notes.alternative: Keep all agents loaded (current state) but document conventions (e.g., 'only invoke frontend-dev if profile is frontend or ticket')
